words.input: CREATE TABLE dbo.Users (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, Name nvarchar(100) NOT NULL, Email nvarchar(255) UNIQUE, Age int NULL, Active bit NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, CreatedAt datetime2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME()); CREATE TABLE dbo.Orders (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, UserId int REFERENCES dbo.Users(Id), Amount decimal(12,2) NOT NULL);
words.annotation: サンプル表：以下の例の基本表（検証用DB向け。同名表がある場合は失敗 SQL Serverの通常の単一列UNIQUEはNULLも通常1件まで。）

words.display:
SELECT u.Id, recent.Amount
FROM dbo.Users u
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT TOP (1) Amount
  FROM dbo.Orders o
  WHERE o.UserId = u.Id
  ORDER BY o.Id DESC
) recent;
words.input: SELECT u.Id, recent.Amount FROM dbo.Users u OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) Amount FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.UserId=u.Id ORDER BY o.Id DESC) recent;
words.annotation: OUTER APPLY：左行に依存する結果

words.display:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CountAll, SUM(Amount) AS Total, AVG(Amount) AS Average
FROM dbo.Orders;
words.input: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CountAll, SUM(Amount) AS Total, AVG(Amount) AS Average FROM dbo.Orders;
words.annotation: COUNT / SUM / AVG：件数・合計・平均（COUNT(列)はNULLを除く）

words.display:
SELECT UserId, SUM(Amount) AS Total
FROM dbo.Orders
GROUP BY UserId
HAVING SUM(Amount) >= 1000;
words.input: SELECT UserId, SUM(Amount) AS Total FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY UserId HAVING SUM(Amount) >= 1000;
words.annotation: GROUP BY / HAVING：グループ集計

words.input: SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(Name AS nvarchar(max)), N', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY Id) FROM dbo.Users;
words.annotation: STRING_AGG：文字列集約（長い結果は入力型の最大長に注意）

words.display:
;WITH Totals AS (
  SELECT UserId, SUM(Amount) AS Total
  FROM dbo.Orders
  GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT *
FROM Totals;
words.input: ;WITH Totals AS (SELECT UserId, SUM(Amount) AS Total FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY UserId) SELECT * FROM Totals;
words.annotation: WITH：クエリに名前（前文を;で終える。CTEの直後の1文で使用）

words.display: INSERT INTO dbo.Users (Name, Email) OUTPUT INSERTED.Id VALUES (N'Pomo', N'pomo@example.com');
words.input: INSERT INTO dbo.Users (Name, Email) OUTPUT INSERTED.Id VALUES (N'Pomo', N'pomo@example.com');
words.annotation: INSERT / OUTPUT：追加して結果を返す（INSERTEDは追加後。トリガー等でOUTPUTの制約あり）

words.display:
UPDATE dbo.Users SET Age = 21 OUTPUT INSERTED.Id, DELETED.Age AS OldAge, INSERTED.Age AS NewAge
WHERE Id = 1;
words.input: UPDATE dbo.Users SET Age = 21 OUTPUT INSERTED.Id, DELETED.Age AS OldAge, INSERTED.Age AS NewAge WHERE Id = 1;
words.annotation: UPDATE / OUTPUT：行更新（WHEREなしは全行更新）

words.input: UPDATE u SET Active = 1 FROM dbo.Users u JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT UserId FROM dbo.Orders) o ON o.UserId = u.Id;
words.annotation: UPDATE ... FROM：結合して更新（各対象が複数行に一致する場合の不定性に注意）

words.display:
DECLARE @n decimal(12, 2) = 123.45, @ok bit = 1, @name nvarchar(100) = N'Pomo';
SELECT @n, @ok, @name;
words.annotation: int / decimal / bit / nvarchar：主な型（金額等には正確なdecimalを検討）

words.display:
SELECT Name, COALESCE(Email, N'未登録'), CASE WHEN Age >= 20 THEN N'成人' ELSE N'その他' END
FROM dbo.Users;
words.input: SELECT Name, COALESCE(Email,N'未登録'), CASE WHEN Age>=20 THEN N'成人' ELSE N'その他' END FROM dbo.Users;
words.annotation: CASE / COALESCE / NULLIF：条件値・NULL処理

words.input: DECLARE @j nvarchar(max)=N'{"name":"Pomo","tags":["sql"]}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.name'), JSON_QUERY(@j,'$.tags'); SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(@j,'$.tags');
words.annotation: JSON_VALUE / JSON_QUERY / OPENJSON：JSONを読む（OPENJSONはDB互換性レベル130以降）

words.input: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.GetUser @Id int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Id=@Id; END;
words.annotation: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE：ストアドプロシージャ（専用バッチで実行。呼出はEXEC dbo.GetUser @Id=1）

words.input: SET XACT_ABORT ON; BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION; UPDATE dbo.Users SET Active=0 WHERE Id=1; COMMIT TRANSACTION; END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION; THROW; END CATCH;
words.annotation: TRY CATCH / XACT_ABORT / TRANSACTION：取引と失敗処理（実データ変更。例外の種類・入れ子取引等により詳細が異なる）

words.input: SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON; SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Id=1; SET STATISTICS IO OFF; SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
words.annotation: 実行計画・統計：I/O・時間を確認（SELECTを実際に実行。SSMSの推定・実際プランも利用）
